explication: Aspire is a multi-language, code-first toolchain for defining distributed applications, running them locally, observing them, and carrying their definitions into deployment. The principal workflow starts with a developer defining services and dependencies in an AppHost; the CLI runs the application, while the dashboard provides observability. The same model can be published through deployment pipelines and provider integrations. The repository also includes a VS Code extension for AppHost development and lifecycle operations. Several subsystem links below reflect README-level capabilities; unsampled implementation details are not inferred.
